title: Live Kubernetes EA-TOCTOU mechanism, DCJI planner-to-commit binding, commit-guard validation, and residual gate-to-actuation instrumentation
conditional_case: F2.1 once per successful cluster session if Pod-IP reuse is naturally reproducible
execution_rule: Run preflight first. Then invoke run_e13_protocol.py --execute exactly once. Attempt 2 is automatic only if attempt 1 records INFRA_FAILURE. Never rerun scientific outcomes or CASE_FAILURE/PASS attempts.
scientific_outcome_rule: Unexpected mechanism, guard, deadline, native-precondition, or control outcomes are retained as scientific data. Attempt PASS means the scheduled trial records executed without case exceptions; it does not mean the expected hypothesis was observed. Safe execute controls also record actual first-actuation timing; this is descriptive instrumentation only.
safety: All destructive actions are restricted to namespace flashir-e13.

dcji_integration.scenario_hash_verification: Each live case verifies its frozen v8.0 scenario hash against deterministic/CONTROLLED_INPUTS_V8.sha256.json before deriving a plan.
dcji_integration.planning_timing: Critical-query planning occurs after decision snapshot and before the induced transition; planning runtime is recorded separately from commit-gate latency.
dcji_integration.commit_timing: Only the planner-selected critical Kubernetes read(s) plus B6 commit evaluation are included in commit-guard latency.

F1.1/F1.2: Kubernetes API DeleteOptions UID precondition comparator

negative_controls.NC-L1: Stable relevant state. DCJI should execute; when it does, the frozen response is actually issued to measure gate-to-first-actuation latency.
negative_controls.NC-L2: Irrelevant annotation mutation while target UID remains unchanged. DCJI should execute; when it does, the frozen response is actually issued to measure false abort and gate-to-first-actuation latency.

deadline_rule: Record transition_deadline_feasible and gate_completed_within_deadline for every trial. A deadline miss is a scientific observation and is not rerun.
latency_boundary: kubectl-based live query latency includes client process plus Kubernetes API latency; it is not a pure apiserver/network measurement.
atomicity_boundary: Client-side DCJI validates the refreshed snapshot but does not serialize Kubernetes state through actuation. gate_to_first_actuation_ms quantifies the residual window. Native server-side preconditions dominate where the exact invariant is exposed.
